source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 19 May 1955, p. 8 ("Municipal election results: Newtownards, Victoria Ward")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: three elected for three seats on the printed votes

note: Election of 12 members for the four wards of Newtownards Borough Council (three each) on 18 May 1955. There was a contest in all four wards after the withdrawal of Mr Henry M'Gimpsey in Castle Ward reduced the field to 17 for 12 seats. Defeated (ward not printed): J. Aigle (Lab.) 307, J. Nixon (Lab.) 308, J. R. H. Pinnons (Lab.) 247, D. Wilson 393, D. Moore (Lab.) 314. Kelly was one of the four new members. Poll 61 per cent. Losers not printed: re-checked on the British Newspaper Archive's page image of the Belfast News-Letter, 19 May 1955, p. 8 (13 Nov 2026): the five defeated candidates are printed with their votes after the four wards' results but without their wards (the first reads 'J. Algie' on the image), so none can be placed in this ward.
